aggregates.claim: A finite ledger over the exact current collected suite, with every execution ID, primary requirement, input/profile fingerprint, current adjudication, declared phase and evidence class bound into the inventory review. Inventory adjudication is distinct from case approval: explicit current needs-oracle or disputed members remain listed, unapproved and ineligible for qualified passes. Unreviewed, stale or falsely labelled reference evidence cannot be silently adopted. Declared-valid runtime effects, other effects, positive admission controls, undefined-result contexts and invalid-input diagnostics have separate populations. Actual observations are joined by exact ID and compiler configuration without adding an execution or attributing a canonical case to this requirement.
aggregates.limitation: Observational infrastructure only: S4.2-001's facet remains pending until the source/requirement census, complete conforming fixture/oracle inventory and separate processor/dependency qualifications are independently established. No finite run proves the universal processor obligation. A filtered invocation retains all unselected members in its denominator. XFAILs remain failures; skips, unsupported modes, missing profiles, unavailable launchers, unexecuted run effects and provisional observations cannot become qualified passes. A compile/link admission is not execution of an interpretation, and a context-only run is not an assertion about an undefined value. Resource failures do not establish permitted size/complexity limits. Compiler headers, companions, launchers and profile observations describe the selected interface, not ABI certification or universal portability. Paragraphs 7-8 are recommendations, not manufactured mandatory documentation requirements.

review.rationale: Explicit source-context renewal of the unchanged 2083-member inventory after the independently reviewed 10.1.6.1, 10.1.6.2, 10.1.6.3, 10.1.7 and 10.1.8 source registration in doc/source_audits/batch_103.json. All 2083 case bindings, their fingerprints, 2047 raw reviews, 198 older catalogues, 22 links, R402 and the b153c75b baseline remain exact. All 20 scoped base units are newly accounted because no numbered item falls in this scope; 63 new facets remain pending, of which nine requirements are effects and one, 10.1.7 p3, is the single restriction. This batch discharges four delegations left open by earlier Clause 10 batches: defined-binary applicability and generic nonapplicability from 10.1.2.9, and the left-recursive grouping facets of 10.1.2.6 and 10.1.2.8 which batch098 correctly refused to claim as value-observable for intrinsic operations. They are carried by a concrete non-associative defined extension, not by truth tables, short-circuit inference or side effects. Every processor freedom is recorded as a permission: 10.1.6.3 p1 equivalent-expression latitude bounded by parenthesis integrity, 10.1.7 p1 needing not evaluate all operands or each entirely, and the 10.1.8 p1 rewrite context, while 10.1.8's counterweight that a parenthesized expression shall be treated as a data entity remains a requirement. A global name-head check over 502 rule heads found 0 missing, 0 duplicate and 0 unmatched, confirming the defined-operator grammar owners stay in 10.1.2. Recorded limits: the 10.1.7 p2 undefined status is not value-observable by reading the entity, and a finite sample can refute but never prove the all-possible-primary-values equivalence of 10.1.6.3 p2. Discharging a delegation means a writable plan now exists, not that a program has been written or run. No defined-operation, operand-evaluation or parenthesis execution, canonical link or SourceUse observation is supplied, and no compiler was invoked. The eight substring executions integrated in batch099 remain the latest actual observations. All pending facets, unresolved units, the retained needs-oracle real-BOZ block and every global gate remain open.
